title: Misty Valley
wikitext:
[[Image:Misty Valley.jpg|thumb|300px|Misty Valley]]

'''Misty Valley''' is located in the northwestern corner of [[Swamp of Sorrows]], north of the entrance to [[Deadwind Pass]].

It is home to [[Tangled Horror]]s, [[Swampwalker Elder]]s and [[Swampwalker]]s and in the far back of the valley is a cave, where the [[Mire Lord]] can be found.
